paper_metadata.title: High-temperature deformation of the NbCr2-based Laves intermetallics in Nb-Cr-V and Nb-Cr-Mo alloy systems

evidence.quote: High-temperature deformation of the C15 NbCr2-based intermetallics in ternary Nb-Cr-V and Nb-Cr-Mo alloy systems is observed in terms of microstructural and compositional effect, by compression testing and transmission electron microscopy (TEM).

High-temperature deformation of the C15 NbCr2-based intermetallics in ternary Nb-Cr-V and Nb-Cr-Mo alloy systems is observed in terms of microstructural and compositional effect, by compression testing and transmission electron microscopy (TEM).
